Thirdly, health care is not a homogenous good. Lastly, lack of health insurance != lack of access to medical care. Particularly once you remove the overhead costs of insurance and the price-inflating effect of billing through insurers, medical services become dramatically cheaper (the Surgery Center of Oklahoma comes to mind).
